x: In the Junior events we saw Alan Law score a good double by winning the 100 and 220 yards, while Brian Trower was another dual winner in the 440 and 880 with Boreham giving him good assistance in both races. Gerry Lines won the 1 mile in good style with W.
"A"—McLean, 18.33; Lines, 18.37; Linstead, 18.09; Edgar, 18.40. "B"—Hooper, 19.13; Mitchell, 18.53; Boreham, 19.06; W.
